title: Missing Strict-Transport-Security response header
description: The response omits Strict-Transport-Security, so the browser stores no instruction to upgrade later requests. The next navigation to this host can still be sent over plaintext, where an on-path attacker can intercept or rewrite it before the redirect to HTTPS happens. HSTS is the only control that removes that first-request window.
remediation: Send Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains once every subdomain serves HTTPS. Start with a short max-age while validating, then raise it; adding preload is a separate, deliberate step.
limitation: Header-name check on one response. It cannot tell whether the host is ever reached over plaintext, and it reports the missing policy rather than an observed downgrade.
